audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Poppy, Level 6 read Skill, First item read Poppy — three rows against both the mirror and the packet.
audit.why: Mirror point 2 flipped exactly rows 1, 4 and 5 in matched pairs, landing on the packet chart. Poppy's own whys already said so: whys[1] 'Even window ... neither commits cleanly yet', whys[4] 'Her spike', whys[5] 'Even again'. Only the side tokens were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page sells Steadfast Presence as a permanent dash-denial aura — 'Your W disables her dashes', 'Hold W up so her Q dash gets grounded and her whole engage pattern dies', 'W keeps denying every Bladesurge reset'. The dash-stop lives on the ACTIVE half, 20/18/16/14/12s; the passive half is armour and magic resist only. Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s and refreshes outright on a Marked target.
audit.why: This is the mirror agent's headline finding from the other side, and it changes the whole lane: you get roughly one dash-stop per two of her dashes, so W has to be spent on the Bladesurge that starts a real all-in rather than the first poke dash. Two further interactions were absent: Flawless Duet cancels Keeper's Verdict (Poppy's R is a channel), and W stops Bladesurge only — Flawless Duet is not a dash and lands through it.
audit.corrected: Stated with both cooldowns in tldr, winCon, tradeBad, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].d, phases[1].why, whys[3], wants.you[0], early, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No lane-facing field explained the anti-heal buy.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals Irelia on every cast, including off minions, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Added to wants.you[2]; mid now credits the heal to Bladesurge rather than to her passive, which does not heal at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block carried no numbers and repeated the W-disables-dashes error.

audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt; Defiant Dance's physical reduction added.

notes: dosFull[2].t reads 'Passive-block her Q dash' — 24 characters, under the applier's 25-character skip threshold, so it cannot be fixed by a normal edit. It is the exact error the mirror agent flagged as structural: the dash-block is the W ACTIVE, not a passive. It needs a manual change to something like 'W-block her Bladesurge'. spikes[1].text carries the same claim ('Hold W (Steadfast Presence) up — it grounds her Q dash') but is long enough to edit; I left it because its 'when' is 'Lvl 1', where holding W really is the whole plan, and rewriting it to add the 20-second caveat would not fit the band without dropping the ability names. Also noting champ-data/_kits/irelia.json gives Flawless Duet a 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support — it is 'damaged, stunned and Marked', no grounding. Nothing was written from it.
